title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - PermissionSpecification
description: A PermissionSpecification defines a permissible action (e.g. read, write) on some function, where a function can be an entity class name or some specific functionality. (TM Forum TMF672 User Role Permission Management API 5.1.0, OpenAPI component PermissionSpecification; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:PermissionSpecification:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PermissionSpecification'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF672_UserRolesPermissions/blob/v5.1.0/TMF672-User_Role_Permission_Management_API-v5.1.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'PermissionSpecification' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF672_UserRolesPermissions/blob/v5.1.0/TMF672-User_Role_Permission_Management_API-v5.1.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF672_UserRolesPermissions/blob/v5.1.0/TMF672-User_Role_Permission_Management_API-v5.1.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF672_UserRolesPermissions/blob/v5.1.0/TMF672-User_Role_Permission_Management_API-v5.1.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:PermissionSpecification:<tmfId>. unique identifier

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF672_UserRolesPermissions/blob/v5.1.0/TMF672-User_Role_Permission_Management_API-v5.1.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/PermissionSpecification/properties/name'. A descriptive name of the permission specification, should summarize to a human user what the purpose is of this permission

examples: User with this permission set can create and edit Product Offerings
description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF672_UserRolesPermissions/blob/v5.1.0/TMF672-User_Role_Permission_Management_API-v5.1.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/PermissionSpecification/properties/description'. A fuller description of the permission specification, should describe to a human user what the purpose is of this permission

function.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF672_UserRolesPermissions/blob/v5.1.0/TMF672-User_Role_Permission_Management_API-v5.1.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/PermissionSpecification/properties/function'. The function to which the action applies, could be an entity class name, in which case the action defines permission to read or modify these entities. E.g. Read ProductOffering. Alternatively, the function is an agreed string that reflects a specific functionality to which access is controlled, such as giving an ad-hoc price reduction in a product order.

action.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF672_UserRolesPermissions/blob/v5.1.0/TMF672-User_Role_Permission_Management_API-v5.1.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/PermissionSpecification/properties/action'. Level of access granted as part of the permission, such as read or write.

specificationCharacteristic.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF672_UserRolesPermissions/blob/v5.1.0/TMF672-User_Role_Permission_Management_API-v5.1.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/PermissionSpecification/properties/specificationCharacteristic'. List of characteristics that are relevant for evaluating the permission. For example, if the permission relates to granting an ad-hoc order price reduction, a characteristic might be defined for the maximum allowed reduction.

allOf.description: This class defines a characteristic specification.

name.description: A word, term, or phrase by which this characteristic specification is known and distinguished from other characteristic specifications.

valueType.description: A kind of value that the characteristic can take on, such as numeric, text and so forth

description.description: A narrative that explains the CharacteristicSpecification.

configurable.description: If true, the Boolean indicates that the target Characteristic is configurable

minCardinality.description: The minimum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on. For example, zero to five phone numbers in a group calling plan, where zero is the value for the minCardinality.

maxCardinality.description: The maximum number of instances a CharacteristicValue can take on. For example, zero to five phone numbers in a group calling plan, where five is the value for the maxCardinality.

isUnique.description: Specifies if the value of this characteristic is unique across all entities instantiated from the specification that uses this characteristic. For example, consider a ProductSpecification for a set-top box, with a CharacteristicSpecification cardID. Each set-top box must have a different value for cardID, so this isUnique attribute would be set to true for the characteristic.

regex.description: A rule or principle represented in regular expression used to derive the value of a characteristic value.

extensible.description: An indicator that specifies that the values for the characteristic can be extended by adding new values when instantiating a characteristic for a resource.

@valueSchemaLocation.description: This (optional) field provides a link to the schema describing the value type.

charSpecRelationship.description: An aggregation, migration, substitution, dependency or exclusivity relationship between/among Specification Characteristics.

characteristicValueSpecification.description: A CharacteristicValueSpecification object is used to define a set of attributes, each of which can be assigned to a corresponding set of attributes in a CharacteristicSpecification object. The values of the attributes in the CharacteristicValueSpecification object describe the values of the attributes that a corresponding Characteristic object can take on.

allOf.description: An aggregation, migration, substitution, dependency or exclusivity relationship between/among Characteristic specifications. The specification characteristic is embedded within the specification whose ID and href are in this entity, and identified by its ID.

relationshipType.description: Type of relationship such as aggregation, migration, substitution, dependency, exclusivity

name.description: Name of the target characteristic within the specification

characteristicSpecificationId.description: Unique identifier of the characteristic within the specification

parentSpecificationHref.description: Hyperlink reference to the parent specification containing the target characteristic

parentSpecificationId.description: Unique identifier of the parent specification containing the target characteristic

allOf.description: specification of a value (number or text or an object) that can be assigned to a Characteristic. This is an abstract base class, the actual value is in one of the strongly-typed subclasses : BooleanArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, BooleanCharacteristicValueSpecification, FloatArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, FloatCharacteristicValueSpecification, IntegerArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, IntegerCharacteristicValueSpecification, MapArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, MapCharacteristicValueSpecification, NumberArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, NumberCharacteristicValueSpecification, ObjectArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, ObjectCharacteristicValueSpecification, StringArrayCharacteristicValueSpecification, StringCharacteristicValueSpecification...

valueType.description: A kind of value that the characteristic value can take on, such as numeric, text and so forth

isDefault.description: If true, the Boolean Indicates if the value is the default value for a characteristic

unitOfMeasure.description: A length, surface, volume, dry measure, liquid measure, money, weight, time, and the like. In general, a determinate quantity or magnitude of the kind designated, taken as a standard of comparison for others of the same kind, in assigning to them numerical values, as 1 foot, 1 yard, 1 mile, 1 square foot.

valueFrom.description: The low range value that a characteristic can take on

valueTo.description: The upper range value that a characteristic can take on

rangeInterval.description: An indicator that specifies the inclusion or exclusion of the valueFrom and valueTo attributes. If applicable, possible values are "open", "closed", "closedBottom" and "closedTop".

regex.description: A regular expression constraint for given value

Extensible.description: Base Extensible schema for use in TMForum Open-APIs - When used for in a schema it means that the Entity described by the schema MUST be extended with the @type

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format
